description: Corrupt lines in a shared export are skipped. Lines without the marker "gen_ai.operation.name" are consumed and counted in read only, even when they hold the text `usage` or are invalid JSON: plain text, an empty line, the tail half of an interleaved span, and a truncated note containing `usage`. Lines with the marker that are not a JSON object count as malformed: a truncated span, two writers interleaved on one line, and a JSON array. A metric line and a non-agent execute_tool span are consumed without effect; all valid chat spans still produce records (record_index counts bytes, with a multi-byte character earlier in the file); one lines_skipped diagnostic carries malformed=3 and read=13 (all complete lines); a trailing partial line is not consumed.
